correctness.rationale: A full pair of adjacent rungs propagates observation along both rims via unique-neighbor forcing; all permitted same-row distances 1,2,3 and cross-row distances 0,1,2 construct consecutive fully observed rungs. A single seed cannot force initially for n>=4, while the triangular prism is a true n=3 exception. For excluded larger-distance pairs each boundary-observed nonseed vertex has at least two unobserved neighbors, so no force starts. Counting cyclic separations gives the piecewise M_n formula. Independent adjacency-matrix dynamics exhausts all singletons and unordered pairs for 3<=n<=39. Finite evidence is not the infinite necessity proof.
